_about: This file is where the game's words live. Each list below is picked from at random, so write as many lines as you like. Leave a list empty ([]) to keep the game's default wording. {name} is replaced by a player's name (or a team's) where noted. Save the file and restart the game to see changes.

_where_each_list_shows.lobby: one line under the ONLINE title in the lobby
_where_each_list_shows.match_start: the banner when a match begins (default: Fight!)
_where_each_list_shows.eliminated: the message when a player dies; use {name} (default: {name} was eliminated)
_where_each_list_shows.win: the winner headline on the results screen; use {name} (default: {name} wins!)
_where_each_list_shows.epilogue: a line under the winner headline on the results screen
_where_each_list_shows.gens: one line of lore shown under each Gen's description when picking it
